reason: I have one apartment next to my house, so if a guest has a question I just walk over or answer on my phone, and ChatGPT already translates for me for free. €120 is real money when I earn about €8,000 a year, and Booking and Airbnb already send the Wi-Fi and check-in messages automatically.
objection: With one unit the guests don't ask me that many questions, and the platforms already do the automatic messages for free, so I don't see what I'm paying for that I can't do myself with ChatGPT.
would_change_my_mind: If it cost around €40 for the whole season, or if a neighbour with one apartment showed me it really cut their messages in August, I'd try it with the refund guarantee.
